title: Keyboard shortcuts
layoutTip: Like a commander, F5 copies and F6 moves. As in Explorer, F5 refreshes, Backspace goes back and a click selects. Your own keys stay as they are.
vimTip: The editor then works like Vim, with normal and insert mode. :w saves and :q closes the file.
clickSelectTip: A click selects a file, a frame drawn with the mouse selects several, and the selection follows the arrow keys. Off, it is as in a commander: a click only moves the cursor, and Ctrl, Shift or Insert mark.
fixed: {key} is taken for good. Pick another key.
letter: Single letters and digits belong to the quick search. Add Ctrl, Alt or an F key.
taken: {key} already belongs to “{action}”. Swap gives “{action}” your current key. Esc leaves everything as it is.
takenAlone: {key} already belongs to “{action}”. Replace moves the key here, Esc leaves everything as it is.
browser: The browser keeps {key} for its tabs and windows. Please pick another one here, it works in the desktop app.
system: {key} belongs to the system and never reaches CannonCommander. Please pick another key.
browserHere: The browser keeps this key. It works in the desktop app.
systemHere: This key belongs to the system.
hint: Click a key and press the new combination
asShipped: The shortcuts are back as shipped
